outline:
課程大綱如下：
1.一階微分方程式
2.二階及高階微分方程式
3.線性微分方程系統
4.常微分方程式之級數解與特殊函數
5.拉氏變換
6.傅立葉級數
7.偏微分方程式
schedule:
1. Ordinary Differential Equations ( ODEs ) of the First Order
2. Linear ODEs of the First Order
3. Electric Circuits
4. Linear ODEs of the Second Order
5. Nonhomogeneous Linear ODEs of the Second Order
6. Laplace Transforms
7. Properties of the Laplace Transforms
8. Convolution, Integral Equations
9. Midterm Exam
10. Partial Fraction Expansions
11. Legendre Polynomials
12. Bessel Functions
13. Orthogonal Expansions
14. Fourier Series
15. Fourier Transform
16. Partial Differential Equations
17. Transmission Line Equations
18. Final Exam
assessment:
1. Attandence
2. Quiz
3. Midterm Exam
4. Final Exam
